title: 10 Biggest Price Target Changes For Tuesday

organizations.name: bank of america cut cognizant technology solutions corp

text: Lisa Levin , Benzinga Staff Writer {{following ? "Following" : "Follow"}} September 04, 2018 9:45am Comments Share: Morgan Stanley boosted the price target for Ulta Beauty Inc (NASDAQ: ULTA ) from $260 to $280. Ulta Beauty shares closed at $260.00 on Friday. Bank of America cut Cognizant Technology Solutions Corp (NASDAQ: CTSH ) price target from $91 to $81. Cognizant Technology shares closed at $78.43 on Friday. Barclays lowered the price target for AT&T Inc. (NYSE: T ) from $40 to $31. AT&T shares closed at $31.94 on Friday. BMO Capital raised the price target on Gartner Inc (NYSE: IT ) from $147 to $161. Gartner shares closed at $149.76 on Friday. Canaccord Genuity increased Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) price target from $220 to $250. Apple shares closed at $227.63 on Friday. Pivotal Research boosted the price target for Zumiez Inc. (NASDAQ: ZUMZ ) from $30 to $36. Zumiez shares closed at $31.15 on Friday. KeyBanc raised the price target for Bandwidth Inc (NASDAQ: BAND ) from $45 to $64. Bandwidth shares closed at $45.56 on Friday. Jefferies increased the price target on Boston Scientific Corporation (NYSE: BSX ) from $34 to $42. Boston Scientific shares closed at $35.56 on Friday. Nomura boosted QUALCOMM, Inc. (NASDAQ: QCOM ) price target from $70 to $80. QUALCOMM shares closed at $68.71 on Friday. Buckingham lifted the price target for RR Donnelley & Sons Co (NYSE: RRD ) from $6 to $8. RR Donnelley & Sons shares closed at $5.06 on Friday. © 2018 Benzinga.com. Benzinga does not provide investment advice. All rights reserved.
